rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Hive Wallet is an agent-native wallet primitive enabling AI agents to provision wallets, transfer USDC on the Base blockchain, and generate cryptographically signed HiveDNA 3-proof receipts for offline verification. Implements the MCP Streamable-HTTP transport and operates as a hosted endpoint.
